'''Ciratu''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Ciratu system/Legends|of the same name]], a part of the [[Immerian Outback/Legends|Immerian Outback]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]],<ref name="Trailing" /> far from the region's [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]. It was orbited by six spheres made up of [[Stone/Legends|rock]] and [[Iron/Legends|iron]] which were known as the [[Ciratu Spheres]]. The spheres were filled with tunnels, and were believed to have been created by an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ciratu was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the star was cut before the book's release. The information regarding Ciratu was later released in [[2013]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> An update to the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and Fry, placed the Ciratu system, and therefore Ciratu, in grid square N-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
